title: Arcane Arquebus
text: Sneak-right-click to open its single crystal slot. Only Target-Projectile and Crosshair-Projectile spells fit. In the main hand, right-click fires only the loaded spell, never the grid sequence. The crystal is not consumed.

Without an upgrade kit, selection distance is quadrupled: 48 blocks for Target and 64 for Crosshair. Spell power gains an additive 30%, and projectile speed doubles. The base firing cooldown is 2 seconds. Base mana cost is doubled before subtracting cost reductions. Offhand holding grants no bonus.

Each arquebus accepts one upgrade kit. The Ancestor Launcher grants concealment and impact explosions; the King's New Clothes grants perception and wall-piercing ghost shots. The kits are mutually exclusive, and installing one preserves the loaded spell crystal.
